messages:
mia (vp_product): sharing the company-level OKR draft for Q3/Q4 — need quick alignment on scope and launch criteria. big themes: 1) Make hosted stable and cost-predictable, 2) Dedicated GA with enterprise parity (VPC + KMS/HSM), 3) Redwood Optimize pushes (batching + quantization recommendations). please call out any absolute blockers.
kevin (eng): skimmed it — looks reasonable. main risk is eng capacity for compiler/kernel work + Dedicated autoscaling. we can do Dedicated GA if we cut nonessential runtime perf experiments.
sam (eng-ml): +1 to kevin. also we should quantify ml-research backlog: model-compiler perf work is 6-8 engineer-months. can we deprioritize one Optimize feature?
Priya (sales): From customers: two deals require HSM + private control plane before EOD Q3, and at least one will push for 99.95% SLA in contract. Sales needs clear commitments or we lose negotiating leverage.
jared (pm): we can narrow Dedicated GA scope: ship with v1 console (no advanced rollout UI) and a documented API. postpone canary rollout UI to Q4. that removes ~3 dev-months. thoughts?
lisa (design): fine with v1 console but onboarding flows must be clear — otherwise support load spikes. need docs + a simple migration checklist.
kevin (eng): okay that trade lowers frontend work. still need to validate autoscaler and fallback routing before GA. can we table compiler f32->int8 kernel work until after GA?
sam (eng-ml): tabling int8 kernels is ok for GA if we provide a clear perf profile that notes expected token cost delta. we can ship with quantization recommendations in docs rather than runtime support.
Priya (sales): if we commit to HSM + private control plane for pilot customers (not general availability), sales can keep pipeline warm. but legal will insist on SLA language — can we offer a staged SLA: pilot (best-effort), GA (contracted SLA)?
mia (vp_product): that staged SLA approach makes sense. propose: pilot customers get private control plane + HSM, GA customers get contracted SLA (99.9 target; negotiable up to 99.95 for strategic accounts).
release-bot: Upcoming: dedicated-cluster-tests scheduled 2026-06-10T02:00Z -> 2026-06-10T06:00Z. Canary window open 6/15-6/22.
lisa (design): note: onboarding checklist for sales + support must be drafted before pilot starts. I'll pair with Priya to create the first pass.
jared (pm): adding an explicit launch criteria checklist — propose we bake this into the GA playbook: ```- SLA target: 99.9% (GA); pilot: best-effort
- Latency: p95 <= 120ms for common 2k token workloads (hosted)
- Autoscaler verified under 2x expected peak load
- Private control plane tested + HSM integration verified with sample KMS
- Docs: onboarding + runbook + migration checklist
- Sales enablement: pricing matrix + negotiation playbook
- Eval gating: basic quality regressions on top customer prompt sets
```
kevin (eng): add: chaos test passing (failover, network partition) and token accounting verified. those must be green before GA.
sam (eng-ml): also add a small perf safety net: if p95 > 200ms under peak the system must automatically fallback to cheaper model variant. simple policy rule is fine for GA.
Priya (sales): agreed. once we have these gates we can publish a non-binding roadmap for customers. ask legal for staged SLA wording — I'll coordinate.
mia (vp_product): good outcomes: 1) Dedicated GA scope = core runtime + autoscaler + private control plane + HSM pilot; 2) Defer model-compiler int8 native kernels to post-GA; 3) Ship Optimize docs + recommendations instead of a runtime-only feature.
mia (vp_product): next steps: kevin/sam to update engineering estimate by EOD Friday, jared/lisa to produce the GA playbook checklist by Monday, Priya to draft customer-facing staged SLA and share with legal. please react with :+1: when you sign off.
kevin (eng): +1 (will update estimates).
sam (eng-ml): +1.
jared (pm): +1 — will draft playbook.
lisa (design): +1 — pairing with Priya.
Priya (sales): +1 (will loop in legal).
mia (vp_product): thanks all — locking this as the company-level slate unless any new blockers surface. if none by EOD Monday we'll roll to exec for final signoff.
